literal_meaning: ঠেঙ্গা দেওয়া বা ছড়ি দিয়ে আঘাত করা (to poke or prod with a stick)
figurative_meaning_en: to teach strictly or force someone to study
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা ছেলেকে ঠেঙ্গাচ্ছে যাতে সে ভালো ফল করে।
example_sentences_in_english: The father is drilling the boy to study hard so he gets good grades.
The teacher is trying to force the students to learn rigorously.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali emphasis on rigorous education in family settings.
